# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from bin/ew/api/cli.json and bin/ew/schemas/. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`ew` is the command-line program of EW: it runs a project headless, with no window. This reference lists its 34 subcommand paths, one page per first word, from the CLI snapshot [`bin/ew/api/cli.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/api/cli.json) and the result schemas in [`bin/ew/schemas`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/tree/main/bin/ew/schemas). Each path gives its flags, its exit codes and the schema of the object that `--json` prints. The synopsis lists the flags only; `ew help` prints the positional arguments too. The conventions (`--project`, `--json`, the exit codes) are [doc 17 §3.1](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#31-conventions). Every subcommand is Preview before 1.0: a breaking change needs a release-note line ([doc 17 §11](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#11-api-stability-and-versioning)).
